sources.name: Nexxus-Drako PCSX2 Cheats Community Fork
sources.author: Nexxus-Drako and upstream code authors
sources.notes: Curated Let's Make A Soccer Team, Virtua Pro Football and Guitar Hero Encore variants. Exact upstream commit URLs are used because no redistribution license is declared.

sources.name: PS2 Widescreen PNACH Database
sources.author: PS2-Widescreen community and original patch authors
sources.notes: Curated ready-to-use widescreen PNACH variants pinned to an exact upstream commit. Staging files are accepted only when a single serial filename and explicit ELF CRC identify the emulator build, syntax is supported, and the patch has meaningful novelty. Direct upstream URLs are used because no redistribution license is declared.

sources.name: Cheat Device PS2 Gameplay Codes
sources.author: root670, Cheat Device PS2 contributors and original code authors
sources.notes: GPL-3.0 gameplay codes converted reproducibly from the pinned CheatDatabase.txt source. Only exact NTSC-U title matches with one unambiguous serial and verified CRC mapping are included; near-duplicate packs are excluded by normalized patch-line comparison.

sources.name: PCSX2 Patches CRC Mapping
sources.author: PCSX2 team and patch contributors
sources.notes: Pinned serial-and-CRC filenames provide compatibility evidence for generated gameplay packs. A separately audited selection of user-facing widescreen, frame-rate, deinterlacing, presentation, control and gameplay options is linked directly to immutable upstream files; disabled or malformed files and normalized duplicates are excluded.

sources.name: DieSkaarj PS2 PNACH Files
sources.author: DieSkaarj and original patch authors
sources.notes: Curated PAL widescreen PNACH files with serial and CRC verified against the pinned PCSX2 patch mapping. Direct immutable upstream URLs are used because no redistribution license is declared.

sources.name: robotshateme Gran Turismo 4 Spec II Tweaks
sources.author: robotshateme and original patch authors
sources.notes: Distinct single-purpose tweaks for the SCUS-97436 Spec II modded build. Each file has unique active patch content and uses an immutable upstream URL because no redistribution license is declared.

sources.name: kimcs17 PS2 Widescreen PNACH Database
sources.author: kimcs17 and original patch authors
sources.notes: Curated ready-to-use widescreen variants with independently verified serial and CRC mappings. A duplicate typo-CRC copy and files awaiting mastercodes are excluded.

sources.name: CW-B-W PCSX2 Cheats

sources.name: WINDROID-EMU PCSX2OID Cheats
sources.author: WINDROID-EMU, GameHacking.org and named code authors

sources.name: NangenX PCSX2 Cheats
sources.author: NangenX and original code authors

sources.name: Gabominated PCSX2 Enhancement Patches
sources.author: Gabominated and the patch authors named in each file
sources.notes: Frame-rate, video-mode, presentation, debug and gameplay enhancements with serial-and-CRC filenames. Only content-distinct files use direct immutable upstream URLs.

sources.name: NetherSX2 Separated Enhancement Patches

sources.notes: PCSX2-derived widescreen, no-interlacing and miscellaneous options separated for NetherSX2. CRC-only files require an unambiguous pre-batch serial mapping and at least 20 percent patch-line novelty; immutable upstream files are used directly.
